services.name: Private Lessons
services.desc: Gathering Lessons is an experimental storytelling theatre piece set in the UrbanGlass Hot Shop. Featuring ten original short plays performed in a random order as decided by the audience, the piece explores the relationship between craft practice and community building by pairing the plays with a live collaborative glassmaking demo. The audience will be presented with a menu of ten small sculptures, one per artist, from which to select the next component to be attached to the collaborative piece. services.name: Point Pulling Class
services.desc: How can we use glass and light as a medium to carry a piece of poetry with us? In this course, we will create 2 to 3 wearable and portable pieces of neon light art that you can bring with you everywhere. We will reconsider the idea of wearable materials and their relationship to our body, and learn how to make glass and neon light as part of an extension of our body that would otherwise not exist. Whether wearing them directly on the body as a fashion accessory or as part of a costume, or carrying portable neon signage for personal and artistic expression, the possibilities are endless.
